place: Bophut, Fisherman's Village, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Beachfront 4-Bedroom Villa with Lawn Pool, Steps from Fisherman's Village
note: Chef & massage on request · utilities metered
blurb: A relaxed four-bedroom villa sitting directly on the sand on Koh Samui's north shore, a hundred metres from Fisherman's Village. A pool set into the lawn runs out toward the water with Koh Phangan on the horizon, and the living and dining rooms slide open on both sides so the sea breeze crosses straight through. Four king bedrooms, dark timber floors and a quiet, contemporary Bali-touched palette.
detail:
This four-bedroom villa sits directly on the beach at Bophut, on Koh Samui's calm north shore, with the sand a step beyond the garden wall and Koh Phangan on the horizon. Fisherman's Village — its evening market, restaurants, bars and shops — is about a hundred metres along the front, and Samui Airport is roughly five kilometres away, so the house combines a genuinely beachfront position with everything within walking distance.

The entrance sets the tone: an antique carved teak door beneath a thatched canopy, flanked by young palms, opening into a house that is otherwise clean and contemporary. Inside, the living and dining rooms occupy one long volume under a pitched ceiling with exposed timber beams, glazed on both sides so the whole space can be opened to the garden on one side and the sea on the other.

A lap pool is set flush into the lawn on the seaward side, edged with sun loungers and framed by mature palms and flowering trees, with an outdoor dining area and a barbecue under the eaves. The garden runs right down to the beach, giving the villa an unusually generous stretch of green for a beachfront plot of 400 m².

All four bedrooms have king beds, air conditioning and ceiling fans, finished with dark hardwood floors, white walls and simple black-and-white photography; several look straight out to the water through sliding doors. The bathrooms are done in large-format grey stone with sculptural vessel basins on timber shelves, walk-in rain showers and glazed slots that bring in daylight.

The kitchen is fully equipped with an oven, dishwasher and full utensils, and there is a TV, safe, iron and hair dryer throughout, plus high-speed fibre WiFi and open-air parking. Bed linen and towels are changed weekly. A private chef, in-villa massage, car and motorbike hire, speedboat charters and island tours can all be arranged; electricity and water are metered and settled at checkout.
